name: Caden Harris
intro: Software developer who builds web applications end to end, from the database to the interface. I've worked on new products and long-running platforms in PHP, Laravel, and TypeScript, and I care about software that stays easy to use and easy to change.

points: Build a large share of SmartXEO, a new Laravel and Livewire CMS and site builder for small towns, working across the whole product. SmartXEO also offers an AI-powered search bar that towns can embed in their existing websites.
Build features and fix bugs across the modules of a large PHP platform for permits, licensing, and code enforcement.
Work with Product, QA, and Support to scope new features and track down bugs.
Provided remote technical support for a legacy collections software suite, resolving 30+ tickets a week by tracing bugs through IMS BASIC, C#, and Python code and finding bad data with SQL.
Wrote troubleshooting guides and led remote training for new and existing customers.
